id: D24-0 gate: boosted-tree heads fitted on the table features plus the sub-frame features
author: first_agent (group manager)
why: The D9 tree blend has raised the public score three times (G1 +3.5e-5, H2a +3.0e-5, H0t +2.4e-5) although the trees read only the 367 table features, while the networks gained most from the 215 sub-frame features (D18-0). Trees that read them too should be better members of the blend. Measured before freeze with the evaluation script on existing files: the TABLE trees blended into the sub-frame network heads (D18 arm S, four networks) give a head proxy of +5.1e-5 out of fold (weights li .32, r_axis .20, kappa .10, x_lower_r .19, q95 .08).
design: D9 setting A unchanged (hist, depth 8, eta .05, 3000 rounds, patience 100 on the calibration table, subsample .8, colsample .5, min_child_weight 20, lambda 1, seed 9; folds and reserved stems of the K-fold protocol), features = 367 table + 215 sub-frame columns (training c86cf095, calibration as D18), eight heads: q95, beta_n, li_scored, r_axis (part a) and z_axis, kappa, x_lower_r, x_lower_z (part b). Host processor, 4 threads, one fold and one part per kernel (ten kernels); a kernel writes its predictions after every finished head.

measure.text: per head: tree R2, nested-blend R2 and weight for the table trees (D9 out-of-fold predictions) and the sub-frame trees against the same network heads (D18 arm S); squared-error ratio of the two blends with a shot bootstrap (2000, seed 990); head proxy (0.15 mean dR2 of q95, betaN + 0.20/7 x shares x dR2 of r_axis, z_axis, kappa, li) of each blend over the network heads and of their difference. Checked before freeze with the table trees in both places: ratio 1 exactly, difference 0.

rule: PASS if the head proxy of the sub-frame-tree blend exceeds that of the table-tree blend by at least +1.0e-5 with P >= .95. PASS -> the trees are refitted on all labelled rows with the 582 features for the heads whose blend improved (P >= .95), predicted on the public test (features = test table + out_public_test sub-frame columns), and blended into the deployed 70 networks at weights = the nested out-of-fold weight of this gate times the factor that carried the D9 weights from four to sixteen networks (to be computed from the P-arm heads and the D9 gate before the build and written into the deployment protocol); one build, one Development submission; deployed if it exceeds the then-deployed score by 1e-5. FAIL -> the table trees stay; closed.
failed_run_note: A kernel cut by the 12 h limit is used as far as it got (finished heads only) and its remaining heads are re-run unchanged; that is recorded.
exposure: All public scores to H3 (.996263) known; D18-0, D9-0 known. No tree fitted on sub-frame features exists at freeze.
rule_3: DIII-D training data only; inputs only.
